name: Toudou Hayato
source:
His parents passed away several years ago, and he inherited the apartment complex that was their asset, which he now runs.
His management is neither good nor bad.
However, he is worried about the recent decline in tenant applicants due to the recession.
When spring comes, a large number of vacant rooms become available, so he places a large-scale advertisement to recruit tenants.
In the middle of this, he remembers something from his childhood and half-jokingly adds "Apartment wife wanted" to the advertisement, which changes his life completely...
